name: colvy-shopify-app
description: Colvy's Shopify app configuration and theme app extension, deployed with the Shopify CLI.

scripts.build: esbuild src/colvy-bis.js --minify --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* Colvy back in stock — built from shopify/src/colvy-bis.js (npm run build). */" --outfile=extensions/colvy-theme/assets/colvy-bis.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && shopify app deploy
